Definition: a seat; figuratively, a site; abstractly, a session; by extension an abode (the place or the time); by implication, population
BiblicalUsage: 1) seat, assembly, dwelling-place, dwelling, dwellers; 1a) seat, sitting, those sitting, sitting company or assembly; 1b) dwelling place, dwelling; 1c) situation, location; 1d) time of dwelling; 1e) those dwelling, dweller
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
